reason: I'd cook the free green curry because it costs nothing, but 99 baht is two plates of rice on my allowance, and I can find tom yum or pad see ew on YouTube for free. I'd stop at the free dishes.
objection: Whether the dishes really come out right when I cook them myself: one free curry turning out okay doesn't prove the other twelve will. When a dish fails I've already wasted 100-150 baht of coconut milk and chicken, and an 'It didn't work' button doesn't give that back.
would_change_my_mind: Let me try one Sunday cook-ahead plan for free. If my week's meals really come out cheaper than a 50-baht plate, the 99 baht pays for itself and I'd buy.
